scope: exact named VPC, optional explicit region; all matching IDs or reject multiple by mandatory parameter

source_strategy.changes: closed named profile and current source-rechecked receipt protocol; no existing freeze edits

name.semantic: nonblank exact UTF-8 text without ASCII controls; no implicit trimming or default

logicalRegionName.semantic: nonblank exact UTF-8 text without ASCII controls; no implicit trimming or default

scope_propagation.name: SQL only; complete parent directory retained for collision checks
scope_propagation.region: absent = no region on API/SQL; supplied = four region-bearing APIs and parent SQL; relation API global
scope_propagation.extra_obligation: reject extra scope/view/column promises, never silently drop
scope_propagation.same_name: all IDs including cross-region or explicit multiple-ID rejection; no arbitrary first

relations.cardinality: region/nativeId identifies at most one ROUTER.id; parent may own many ports

relations.scope: resolved SUBNET has same parent/port region
relations.cardinality: many edges; DISTINCT (parent ID,nonempty subnet reference) before counts
many EIP IDs per parent, separate aggregation

output_count_meanings.resolved_subnet_count: distinct referenced IDs resolved in same region
output_count_meanings.referenced_subnet_count: nonempty opaque subnet references, not only resolved objects
output_count_meanings.known_eip_count: distinct EIP IDs with proven same-region parent, unknown owners separate

envelope.request: exact corresponding build.api_call, autoPagination strictly True
envelope.schema: verified declared columns including successful empties
envelope.pages: nonempty list of complete sequential successful page receipts

receipt.state: ok and declared success strictly True; error only None,False,empty text; every declared http_status/httpStatus/status_code strictly integer nonbool 2xx
receipt.pagination: 1-based pages; stable total/pageSize; exact per-page length; totalPageNo ceil or 0/1 for zero; exact overall row/page count
receipt.identity: strict unique nonblank string ID within each CI across all pages; repeated object IDs reject even projection-identical
receipt.schema: all column keys required; optional missing per-row EIP.routerId becomes unknown NULL under verified column schema
receipt.trust: B current request/schema/full-page assertions, not server authentication, atomic snapshot or business certification

unknown_and_failure.normalization: only empty/blank/NULL foreign keys to NULL; opaque nonblank text preserved
unknown_and_failure.typed_empty: successful zero-total typed table; no placeholder row
unknown_and_failure.no_children: parent retained with known zero counts
unknown_and_failure.failure: missing or invalid receipts, failed HTTP, type/schema drift, duplicates, incomplete pages, wrong-region response, parent collision, resolved cross-region edges reject
unknown_and_failure.partial_graph: known counts retained but known_local_graph_complete=false for any unknown parent name/native, port owner, orphan relation port, selected unknown/unresolved subnet, unknown/unresolved EIP parent
unknown_and_failure.conservative_global_unknowns: cannot certify they are outside selected scope; known graph completeness remains false
unknown_and_failure.local_complete_is_not: official original business acceptance, B runtime adoption or source authenticity

prepared_protocol.input_evidence: deep-copied actual current params and five receipts with digest; no historical content whitelist
prepared_protocol.execution_check: re-run current _prepare, compare canonical projection/diagnostics; version marker/digest alone cannot override failed receipts
prepared_protocol.transmission: evidence is local validation metadata, excluded from static API+SQL; if B transmits it, measure full real payload

entrypoints.prepare: bound current receipt validation and projected typed tables
entrypoints.execute_prepared: recheck actual evidence then synthetic SQLite
entrypoints.execute_local: prepare then synthetic SQLite, no IO

transport.boundary: compact sorted ensure_ascii=False UTF-8 JSON of api_call+sql
transport.oversize: blocked_core_length; no truncation, no declaration that long legal entity is business-invalid
transport.depth: LENGTH_BOUNDARIES.json specifies separate dictionary-only and all-container algorithms; official algorithm unconfirmed

integration_gates: B trustworthy current capture/request/namespace and snapshot consistency
B verified typed-empty loader and validated projection binding
final full envelope byte/depth gate and official business semantics
native PORT duplicate IDs still reject; no canonicalization/data edits
not_supported: VM hierarchy or full EIP-to-VM ownership
name substring or arbitrary first same-name identity
cross_step_contract: complete five-resource catalog plan requires no dynamic dependency placeholder; B may optimize only after separately proving equivalent uniqueness, coverage, unknown exclusion and trustworthy current execution binding
